[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Merge Sorted Array** [LC 88 · Merge Sorted Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/merge-sorted-array/){difficulty="Easy"}

Merging two sorted runs from the *front* needs a separate output buffer, because writing the smallest value into $\mathit{nums1}[0]$ would clobber a value you have not read yet. But $\mathit{nums1}$'s tail is free space, and both inputs are sorted — so fill **from the back**: the largest of the remaining values always belongs at the current far-right slot, and that slot is one you have already vacated or that was free from the start.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p3-a.]{.card-link}

:::
